spec_match.rationale: Real focus-existing manifest with shortcuts and a launchQueue consumer that records userActivation.isActive and the real window.open() result.

interactive.rationale: Policy select, install button, clear log, and two clearly labelled simulation buttons.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers switch-in-place fallback and pre-160 state; real launch deliveries need an installed app (manual).

references.rationale: Links the chromestatus.com/feature/<id> entry and the spec section.

conformance.rationale: Observation route for the suite's manual delivery assertions.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 via Playwright: tab mode labelled manual; simulated active delivery isActive true, expired isActive false. Headless Chromium has no popup blocker, so window.open succeeded without activation; the page now says so instead of claiming success. No real installed-app launch was performed.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts real deliveries' activation; simulations assert separately.

design_system.rationale: Only design-system CSS variables (shared demo.css), buttons set background and color together, AA contrast verdict colours.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled native controls, keyboard operable, visible focus, verdicts in polite live regions, tables with captions and scoped headers.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Driven headless at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch: 0px horizontal overflow, all controls ≥44px, zero console errors or failed requests.

openQuestions.title: Record a real installed-app launch on Chrome 160
openQuestions.detail: Install the app, open workspace alpha, launch the Beta shortcut, and capture the log row (isActive true, window opened). Repeat on a pre-160 build for the contrast.

guidanceConsulted.query: live region status updates for asynchronous results
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce asynchronous verdicts through polite live regions; give every control a programmatic label; keep visible focus.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Verdicts and outputs are aria-live polite (high-frequency readouts use aria-live off), every select/input has a <label for>, focus-visible outline via demo.css.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Let control rows wrap, constrain form controls to the container, and wrap long monospace strings.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Flex-wrap control rows, labels/selects max-width 100%, tables in overflow-x containers, overflow-wrap:anywhere on outputs and long breadcrumbs; 0px document overflow measured at 360px.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native controls with visible labels and ≥44px targets; expose toggle state with aria-pressed.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Native select/range/text inputs with labels, 44px min-height on all controls; toggle buttons expose aria-pressed where they toggle.

guidanceConsulted.query: web app launch handler launchQueue focus-existing
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Give the manifest a stable id, link it from the document, offer navigator.install() with a beforeinstallprompt/menu fallback.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: manifest.json declares a stable id and launch_handler; workspace-app links it and shows an install button only when navigator.install or beforeinstallprompt is available, else menu instructions.

summary: Real focus-existing manifest with shortcuts and a launchQueue consumer that records userActivation.isActive and the real window.open() result. Headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 via Playwright: tab mode labelled manual; simulated active delivery isActive true, expired isActive false. Headless Chromium has no popup blocker, so window.open succeeded without activation; the page now says so instead of claiming success. No real installed-app launch was performed.
